parsed.reason: The parent was saying more messages are on the way. The right reply is one short line, such as "Ready when you are." Instead, Hale questions them ("Two more what, or who?") and invents a reading about kids joining an activity. It then asks them to pick an event. That hands a needless task back to a parent who only said wait, and the reply carries two asks plus padding. It doesn't do the job.
